necessary_actions.explanation: The only acquired poison bottle was sealed and full when the preparation room opened at 6:20. It was empty when the room was locked at 6:28. It was unavailable before opening and after closure. The murderer personally took its contents; no accomplice or separate poison source exists in this fictional case.

The glass was inside intact blue protective wrapping under staff watch until 6:40. Its inside was accessible until staff covered and sealed it at 6:44. The cover stayed sealed until the watched 6:46 pour, followed by the 6:49 toast. The same glass was used throughout; the shared punch was not poisoned.

inference_limit: Documents establish access and object custody. Scripted testimony supplies personal actions. Laboratory comparison is fictional case evidence, not proof that any real chemical can be uniquely traced to one bottle. No dosage or preparation is specified.
